title: Architectural Transformation Scope, Run-Doc Consolidation, and Strict Tier 2 Build-Time AOT Measurement

rules.game_logic_origin: Ahead-of-time (AOT) static C++ compiled from pinned PS2 retail executables and overlays, transformed to typed native memory and ABI (zero g_ram, zero c.r, zero $gp, zero 32-bit guest vtables).
rules.hand_written_boundary: Hand-written native C++ is restricted strictly to platform boundaries (files, display/GL, SDL2, audio, input, threading) and verified runtime services.
rules.xbox_scope: Limited strictly to renderer, viewport, and HD presentation per DECISION_OWNER_CORRECTIONS_20261124; GS packet decoding is an interim concession, not a target.
rules.tier2_aot_definition: AOT-generated counts strictly build-time static C++ output measured from generator unit tables and overlay manifests, never runtime RAM slices or unmeasured estimates.
rules.doc_discipline: Update all relevant current documents in place (README.md, TASK_BOARD.md, PORT_STATUS.md, ROADMAP.md, HANDOFF.md, REPO_LAYOUT.md, NATIVE_PORT_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md); never spawn competing root status docs, file:/// links, machine-local paths, or time estimates.
